create.name: Pilin Anice
create.bio:
Pilin Anice (said puh-LYNN) grew up in Flint, Michigan, and first met yoga, meditation and West African dance as a theatre student at Howard University. She went on to work as a performer in New York, on stage Off-Broadway and on national tours and in a long run of television commercials, while her own practice deepened alongside. She is a 500-hour registered yoga teacher who trained at Kripalu in pranayama, Ayurveda and meditation, studied nutrition at the Institute for Integrative Nutrition, and has spent close to twenty years learning Dunham technique and the dances of West Africa, Haiti, Cuba and Brazil.

Now lead faculty at Kripalu, she teaches breath-led vinyasa, restorative and gentle yoga, yoga dance and meditation, often with live drumming, and leads the centre's welcome weekends and its teacher training for practitioners of the global majority. She also teaches at the Ailey Extension in New York and holds a monthly class with live music at Grace Farms in New Canaan, Connecticut. Online, her PAL app offers a subscription library of yoga, barre, meditation and plant-based recipes, and she runs small Restore & Explore retreats abroad. Her classes are warm and community-minded, with room for everyone to move in their own way.

courses.title: Essential Practices for Everyday Life: Practical Tools from the Kripalu Path
courses.description: A weekend introduction to the Kripalu way of practising, led in turn by Kripalu faculty. You try Kripalu Yoga, meditation, simple daily self-care and time outdoors, with an emphasis on kindness towards yourself.

courses.title: Breathe, Feel, Flow: A Kripalu Vinyasa Immersion
courses.description: A weekend of vinyasa yoga at Kripalu taught as a moving meditation, with breath leading each sequence. Pilin balances strong flowing practice with stillness and reflection.

courses.title: The PAL App
courses.description: Her subscription app with classes in vinyasa, hatha, gentle and restorative yoga, barre, yoga dance, yoga nidra and guided meditation, plus plant-based recipes and Ayurvedic self-care. Members also get a community chat.
courses.price: $20 USD a month or $200 USD a year

courses.title: Monthly Yoga and Movement at Grace Farms
courses.description: A monthly breath-centred yoga class in the Court at Grace Farms in New Canaan, Connecticut, played along to live acoustic music and followed by a cup of tea.
courses.price: $30 USD ($24 USD for Grace Farms members)

courses.title: Living From the Heart: A Six-Week Journey of Affirmation & Alignment
courses.description: A six-week mentorship using guided practice, reflection and affirmation to help you let go of old habits and live closer to what matters to you. Places are by application through a short form.

free_resources.title: 10 Min Meditation - Begin Again With Love
free_resources.description: A free ten-minute guided meditation on her YouTube channel for starting over gently, resting attention on the breath and on kindness towards yourself.
